title: Why Do We Need to Drink Water? 💧 Fun Facts for Kids
description:
Your body is more than half water! Leo asks, big sister Mia explains all the jobs water does inside you, in under a minute.

Curio Kids Club: short, curious answers to kids' big questions. Subscribe: https://www.youtube.com/@CurioKidsClub

lines.text: Mia, why do we need to drink water?
Because your body is more than half water! It's in your blood, your muscles, and even your brain.
What does all that water do?
Lots of jobs! It carries good stuff from your food all around your body, and it helps you digest your lunch.
It keeps you cool, too. When you get hot, you sweat, and as the sweat dries, it cools your skin.
So I lose water when I sweat?
Yes! You lose a little when you sweat, when you breathe out, and when you go to the toilet. So we need to fill back up!
How do I know when I need a drink?
Your body tells you! Feeling thirsty is your body's way of saying, 'Water, please!'
So sip some water through the day, especially when it's hot or you've been running around.
Water carries good stuff, keeps me cool, and helps me feel great!
Cheers to that! Follow Curio Kids Club for more wonders. And next time someone asks... why do we need to drink water?
